Name: Better Furniture Catalogue
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
The Stardew 1.6 update added new themed catalogues that are really cool, but sometimes you just want everything in one place so you can see all your options! Or maybe you're like me and you're still playing through the new 1.6 content, but you wish all the old 1.5 items were available in the Furniture Catalogue. This mod adds several config options for the Furniture Catalogue (and the wallpaper/floor Catalogue).


[b]CONFIGURATION OPTIONS[/b]

[b]Furniture Catalogue[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Default[/b] option adds all the Stardew 1.5 furniture & decor items that were missing, including festival shop inventory, museum rewards, movie theater prizes, and rare/secret items. It also adds a small number of new 1.6 items that are available at regular shops.
[*][b]Extended[/b] option includes everything from "Default", and adds all 1.6 furniture & decor items that are missing from the new themed catalogues.
[*][b]Complete[/b] option adds all furniture & decor items in the game, including those found in the new themed catalogues. 
[*][b]Do not choose "Extended" or "Complete" if you're trying to avoid 1.6 spoilers![/b]
[*]All versions include some "functional" items such as the telephone, mini-fridge, arcade systems, etc. for decoration purposes. (This does [b]not[/b] include artisan machines, furnaces, scarecrows, etc. that are primarily for running your farm and making a profit.)
[*][b]PLEASE NOTE: [/b]Some items, such as seasonal plants/decor, stone statues, arcade systems, etc. are technically "big craftables" rather than "furniture". This means that they will only appear on the top tab (the open book icon), at the end of the list. The other tabs for furniture categories are automatically sorted by the game, so unfortunately I can't add big craftables to them. I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22379]Catalogue Filter - Continued[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ for an easier way to find items, rather than scrolling through the whole list!
[/list][b]Resize Furniture Catalogue[/b]
[list]
[*][i](Off by default)[/i] Changes the Furniture Catalogue to a 1-tile footprint like the other catalogues.
[*]Optional recolors available for the smaller Furniture Catalogue sprite (designed to match Vibrant Pastoral Recolor + DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors)
[*][b]NOTE:[/b] If you change this setting while playing, you may find that the sprite changes but the actual size of the Furniture Catalogue does not change. Just pick it up and place it down again to reset the size!
[/list][b]Wallpaper & Floor Catalogue[/b]
[list]
[*][i](On by default)[/i] Adds the new 1.6 wallpapers & floors to the Catalogue sold at Pierre's shop.
[/list][b]Note:[/b] Config menu text is available in [b]French[/b] (included in the mod -- thanks to Caranud for the translation!) and [b]Chinese[/b] (see "Translations" section above).


[b]REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY[/b]

[list]
[*]Only for Stardew 1.6
[*]Requires Content Patcher
[*]Probably not compatible with other mods that add [b]vanilla[/b] furniture items to the catalogues -- May cause missing or duplicate items
[*]Should be compatible with mods that add [b]custom[/b] furniture items to the game, as long as they're updated for 1.6 -- You will need to choose the "Complete" config option in this mod
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ (as long as you've updated that mod to version 2.1.0 or higher)
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22379]Catalogue Filter - Continued[/url]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20686]Cheaper and More Accessible Catalogues[/url]
[/list]

[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
